pt.B: Toda a comunidade dos israelitas se reuniu em Siló, e ali armaram a tenda do encontro. A terra já estava subjugada diante deles.

decisions.choice: Shiloh: a town in the hill country of Ephraim, now the place of worship
decisions.reason: Shiloh lay in the hills north of Bethel, in the land just given to Ephraim (Judges 21:19). The tent of meeting stood there through the time of the judges, and Eli and Samuel served there (1 Samuel 1:3, 9; 3:21). Its later ruin became a warning to Judah (Jeremiah 7:12-14; Psalm 78:60).

decisions.choice: set up the tent of meeting: pitched it to stay there
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause to dwell or settle. The same root gives the word for the tabernacle, the LORD's dwelling place. The tent that traveled with Israel through the wilderness and stood at Gilgal (5:10; 9:6) now has a settled home in the land, as Deuteronomy 12:10-11 looked forward to.

decisions.choice: the land had been subdued: a background statement, not a new event
decisions.reason: The clause describes the state of things when the people gathered. The wars of chapters 6-12 had broken the power of the kings of the land, though much ground was still to be taken (13:1; 17:12-13). The word "subdued" echoes the charge to subdue the earth (Genesis 1:28) and the promise of Numbers 32:22, 29.

decisions.choice: congregation: Israel gathered as one people
decisions.reason: The word is used for the whole people of Israel as a body that meets before the LORD, as often in Exodus and Numbers.

decisions.choice: All the Israelites ... the meeting tent
decisions.reason: Readable says "all the Israelites" for "all the congregation", since the point is the whole people, and uses "the meeting tent" for the tent of meeting, as in Exodus and Leviticus.

decisions.choice: The land now lay subdued / By now the land was under their control
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the last clause a sentence of its own, with "now", so it reads as the background to what follows (m3).

decisions.choice: "la comunidad"; "la Tienda del Encuentro" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list sets: the congregation is "la comunidad", and the tent of meeting is "la Tienda del Encuentro", which names the tent by its purpose, the meeting of the LORD with his people. Readable keeps the name, as it is short and plain already.

decisions.choice: "la tente de la Rencontre" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets for the ohel moed. The English Readable says "the meeting tent"; French keeps the one name, which is already plain, at every level.

decisions.choice: "Lều Hội Kiến" for the tent of meeting at every level
decisions.reason: The tent where the LORD met with his people; the same name at every level so a reader knows it is the one tent of Exodus.

decisions.choice: "회막" for the tent of meeting at every level
decisions.reason: "회막" is the established Korean word and the term settled for the Pentateuch, so it is kept at every level here too; "만남의 장막" would spell out its meaning at Readable but part from the wording of Exodus to Numbers.

decisions.choice: Siló; armaram a tenda do encontro (every level)
decisions.reason: "Siló" is the Brazilian form of the name, as Genesis 49:10 has it in Portuguese. "A tenda do encontro" is the Pentateuch's term (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), kept at Readable too where the English Readable says "meeting tent". "Armar" is the plain verb for pitching a tent to stay (m2); "tabernáculo" stays with the other word, mishkan.

ko.B: 그러나 이스라엘 자손 가운데는 아직 유산을 나누어 받지 못한 지파가 일곱이나 남아 있었다.

pt.R: Mas sete das tribos de Israel ainda não tinham recebido a sua parte da terra.

decisions.choice: had not divided their inheritance: had not yet had their share of land assigned
decisions.reason: The verb means to divide or share out. Judah and the two tribes of Joseph had received their land (chapters 15-17), and Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh had theirs east of the Jordan (13:8). The other seven, Benjamin, Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Dan, had no share yet (chapters 18-19).

decisions.choice: inheritance: the land held for good by a tribe and passed down in its families
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:2, the word names a lasting possession that comes from the LORD and stays in the family.

decisions.choice: had not been given their inheritance / had not received their share
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "they had not divided" means that no share had been marked out for them. Balanced and Readable say what that meant for the seven tribes.

ko.B: 그래서 여호수아가 이스라엘 자손에게 말했다. "너희 조상의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주신 땅을 차지하러 들어가는 일을 언제까지 머뭇거리겠느냐?

pt.L: E Josué disse aos filhos de Israel: "Até quando vocês se mostram frouxos para ir tomar posse da terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos pais de vocês, deu a vocês?
pt.B: Então Josué disse aos israelitas: "Até quando vocês vão hesitar em ir tomar posse da terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos {{gender:antepassados|pais}} de vocês, deu a vocês?
pt.R: Então Josué perguntou aos israelitas: "Até quando vocês vão esperar para entrar e tomar a terra? {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos {{gender:antepassados|pais}} de vocês, já deu essa terra a vocês.

decisions.choice: showing yourselves slack: holding back, letting your hands drop
decisions.reason: The verb means to sink or grow slack, used of hands that hang down from weariness or lack of will (2 Samuel 4:1; Proverbs 18:9). Its reflexive form here means "make yourselves slack": the seven tribes are failing to act on what is already theirs, not being stopped by anyone.

decisions.choice: until when: how long
decisions.reason: The question is a rebuke, not a request for a date, as in Exodus 10:3 and Numbers 14:11.

decisions.choice: has given you: the gift is already made
decisions.reason: The verb is in the completed form. The LORD, who promised the land to the fathers (Genesis 15:18; 26:3; 28:13), has given it already; the tribes have only to go and take what is theirs. "The God of your fathers" ties the gift to that promise.

decisions.choice: hold back (B), wait (R)
decisions.reason: "Be slack" is the Literal wording. Balanced says "hold back from" and Readable "wait before you go in", which give the sense in common words (m1).

decisions.choice: How long will you wait ...? The LORD ... has given it to you.
decisions.reason: Readable puts the description of the land in a second sentence so the question stays short.

decisions.choice: "ustedes" forms by default ("se mostrarán", "les ha dado"); "vosotros" forms with the plural-you setting ("os mostraréis", "os ha dado")
decisions.reason: For Joshua 13-24, as in the Pentateuch: wherever several people are addressed, Spanish must choose a plural form. The default is the "ustedes" form used by most Spanish speakers; the plural-you setting gives the "vosotros" form of Spain, on each verb, pronoun and possessive that changes. Where one person is addressed, Spanish uses "tú", with no setting.

decisions.choice: Joshua speaks to the people as "anh em" and of himself as "tôi"
decisions.reason: Joshua addresses Israel as one of them, its leader under the LORD, not as a master; "các ngươi" would make him speak as God or a king does.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ" (Literal); "tổ tiên" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Both mean the forefathers of a people and include the whole line; "tổ tiên" is the everyday word, so no gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: Joshua speaks to the assembled people in the plain style (해라체: "미루겠느냐")
decisions.reason: As Moses did, Joshua speaks to Israel as its leader; the plain style keeps the voice of command and rebuke that his question carries (meaning decision m1). This holds for his speeches in chapters 18-24.

decisions.choice: "너희 조상" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "조상" already means forebears, men and women, and is also the word a traditional reader expects, so Korean has nothing for the gender setting to change.

decisions.choice: se mostram frouxos (L); hesitar (B); esperar (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is used of hands that hang slack (m1). Literal keeps that picture with "frouxos", in the reflexive "se mostram"; Balanced says "hesitar em ir", and Readable "esperar", as the English levels do (r-en-1). Joshua speaks to the people with "vocês" (1:2).

source.text: הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑בֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵ֗ם וְיָקֻ֜מוּ וְיִֽתְהַלְּכ֥וּ בָאָ֛רֶץ וְיִכְתְּב֥וּ אוֹתָ֛הּ לְפִ֥י נַֽחֲלָתָ֖ם וְיָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Provide for yourselves three men for [each] tribe, and I will send them, and they will arise and walk about in the land and write it according to [the] mouth of their inheritance, and they will come to me.

en.L: Provide for yourselves three men for each tribe, and I will send them out, and they will arise and walk about in the land and write it up according to their inheritance, and they will come [back] to me.
en.B: Choose three men from each tribe, and I will send them out. They are to set out and go through the land, write a description of it with a view to dividing it as their inheritance, and then come back to me.
en.R: Choose three men from each tribe. I will send them to travel through the land. They will write down what it is like, so that it can be divided among the tribes as their own land. Then they will come back to me.

sw.L: Jipatieni watu watatu kwa kila kabila, nami nitawatuma, nao wataondoka na kutembea katika nchi, na kuiandika kufuatana na urithi wao, nao watarudi kwangu.
sw.B: Chagueni watu watatu kutoka kila kabila, nami nitawatuma. Waondoke, wazunguke katika nchi, waandike maelezo yake kwa ajili ya kuigawa kuwa urithi wao, kisha warudi kwangu.
sw.R: Chagueni watu watatu kutoka kila kabila. Nitawatuma wasafiri katika nchi yote. Wataandika jinsi nchi ilivyo, ili igawanywe kati ya makabila iwe nchi yao wenyewe. Kisha watarudi kwangu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Escojan|Escoged}} para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tres hombres por cada tribu, y yo los enviaré, y se levantarán y recorrerán la tierra y la describirán por escrito conforme a su heredad, y volverán a mí.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escojan|Escoged}} tres hombres de cada tribu, y yo los enviaré. Saldrán a recorrer la tierra, escribirán una descripción de ella pensando en repartirla como heredad, y luego volverán a mí.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escojan|Escoged}} tres hombres de cada tribu. Yo los enviaré a recorrer la tierra. Escribirán cómo es, para que se pueda repartir entre las tribus como su propia tierra. Después volverán a mí.

fr.L: Fournissez-vous trois hommes par tribu, et je les enverrai, et ils se lèveront et parcourront le pays et le décriront selon leur héritage, et ils reviendront vers moi.
fr.B: Choisissez trois hommes dans chaque tribu, et je les enverrai. Ils partiront parcourir le pays, ils en feront une description en vue du partage de leur héritage, puis ils reviendront vers moi.
fr.R: Choisissez trois hommes dans chaque tribu. Je les enverrai parcourir le pays. Ils écriront comment il est, pour qu’on puisse le partager entre les tribus. Ce sera leur terre à eux. Puis ils reviendront vers moi.

vi.L: Hãy chọn cho anh em mỗi chi tộc ba người, và tôi sẽ sai họ đi; họ sẽ đứng dậy đi khắp xứ và ghi chép nó theo sản nghiệp của họ, rồi họ sẽ trở về với tôi.
vi.B: Hãy chọn mỗi chi tộc ba người, và tôi sẽ sai họ đi. Họ sẽ lên đường đi khắp xứ, ghi lại mô tả về xứ để chia làm sản nghiệp, rồi trở về với tôi.
vi.R: Hãy chọn mỗi chi tộc ba người. Tôi sẽ sai họ đi khắp xứ. Họ sẽ ghi lại xứ ấy như thế nào, để có thể chia cho các chi tộc làm đất riêng. Rồi họ sẽ trở về với tôi.

ko.L: 너희를 위하여 각 지파에서 세 사람씩 내세워라. 그러면 내가 그들을 보내겠고, 그들이 일어나 그 땅을 두루 다니며 그들의 유산에 따라 그것을 기록하고 나에게 올 것이다.
ko.B: 각 지파에서 세 사람씩 뽑아라. 내가 그들을 보내겠다. 그들은 길을 떠나 그 땅을 두루 다니면서, 유산으로 나눌 수 있도록 그 땅을 글로 적은 다음 나에게 돌아올 것이다.
ko.R: 각 지파에서 세 사람씩 뽑아라. 내가 그들을 보내어 그 땅을 두루 다니게 하겠다. 그들은 그 땅이 어떤지 적어 와서, 그 땅을 지파들에게 나누어 줄 수 있게 할 것이다. 그러고 나서 나에게 돌아올 것이다.

pt.L: Providenciem para vocês três homens por tribo, e eu os enviarei; e eles se levantarão, e percorrerão a terra, e a descreverão por escrito segundo a sua herança, e virão [de volta] a mim.
pt.B: Escolham três homens de cada tribo, e eu os enviarei. Eles devem partir, percorrer a terra e descrevê-la por escrito, para que seja repartida como herança, e depois voltar até mim.
pt.R: Escolham três homens de cada tribo. Eu vou mandar esses homens percorrer a terra. Eles vão descrever por escrito como ela é, para que a terra possa ser dividida entre as tribos como propriedade delas. Depois eles vão voltar até mim.

decisions.choice: provide: appoint, put forward
decisions.reason: The verb means "give", here as a call to act: "give yourselves", that is, choose and put forward. It is the same word that opens Deuteronomy 1:13, where the tribes are told to choose wise men for Moses to appoint.

decisions.choice: three men for each tribe: twenty-one men from the seven tribes
decisions.reason: The men come from the seven tribes still waiting for land, so that each has a voice in how the land is described. Whether the other tribes sent men as well is not said.

decisions.choice: walk about in the land and write it: survey the land and record it in writing
decisions.reason: The first verb, in a form that means to go to and fro, is used of Abraham walking through the land God gave him (Genesis 13:17). The second is the ordinary word "write": they are to set down a written account of the land, its towns and regions (verse 9), on which the division can be made.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of their inheritance: with a view to their inheritance
decisions.reason: "According to the mouth of" means "in proportion to" or "as fits". The description is to serve the shares each tribe will receive, so it must show what the land can support.

decisions.choice: with a view to dividing it as their inheritance / so that it can be divided among the tribes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make plain what the written description is for (m4).

decisions.choice: percorrer a terra e descrevê-la por escrito (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (verses 4, 6, 8, 9). The men walk through the land and set down a written account of its towns and regions (m3). "Escrever a terra" is not Portuguese, and "mapear" or "levantamento" would suggest a map or modern surveying; "descrever a terra", with "por escrito" where the writing matters, says what they did. "Percorrer" keeps the walking to and fro.

source.text: וְהִֽתְחַלְּק֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֑ים יְהוּדָ֞ה יַעֲמֹ֤ד עַל־גְּבוּלוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב וּבֵ֥ית יוֹסֵ֛ף יַעַמְד֥וּ עַל־גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִצָּפֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will divide it into seven portions; Judah will stand on its territory from [the] south, and [the] house of Joseph will stand on their territory from [the] north.

en.L: And they will divide it into seven portions. Judah will stay in its territory on the south, and the house of Joseph will stay in their territory on the north.
en.B: They are to divide it into seven portions. Judah will keep its territory in the south, and the house of Joseph will keep theirs in the north.
en.R: They will divide the land into seven parts. Judah will stay in its own land in the south, and Joseph's tribes will stay in their land in the north.

sw.L: Nao wataigawa katika mafungu saba. Yuda atakaa katika eneo lake upande wa kusini, na nyumba ya Yusufu itakaa katika eneo lao upande wa kaskazini.
sw.B: Waigawe katika mafungu saba. Yuda atabaki na eneo lake upande wa kusini, na nyumba ya Yusufu itabaki na eneo lake upande wa kaskazini.
sw.R: Wataigawa nchi katika sehemu saba. Yuda atabaki katika nchi yake upande wa kusini, na makabila ya Yusufu yatabaki katika nchi yao upande wa kaskazini.

es.L: Y la repartirán en siete porciones. Judá se quedará en su territorio al sur, y la casa de José se quedará en su territorio al norte.
es.B: La dividirán en siete porciones. Judá conservará su territorio en el sur, y la casa de José conservará el suyo en el norte.
es.R: Dividirán la tierra en siete partes. Judá se quedará en su propia tierra en el sur, y las tribus de José se quedarán en su tierra en el norte.

fr.L: Et ils le partageront en sept parts. Juda se tiendra sur son territoire au sud, et la maison de Joseph se tiendra sur son territoire au nord.
fr.B: Ils le partageront en sept parts. Juda gardera son territoire au sud, et la maison de Joseph gardera le sien au nord.
fr.R: Ils partageront le pays en sept parties. Juda restera dans son pays au sud, et les tribus de Joseph resteront dans leur pays au nord.

vi.L: Họ sẽ chia nó làm bảy phần. Giu-đa sẽ ở trong địa phận mình ở phía nam, và nhà Giô-sép sẽ ở trong địa phận họ ở phía bắc.
vi.B: Họ sẽ chia xứ làm bảy phần. Giu-đa sẽ giữ địa phận của mình ở phía nam, còn nhà Giô-sép giữ địa phận của họ ở phía bắc.
vi.R: Họ sẽ chia đất làm bảy phần. Giu-đa sẽ ở lại trong đất của mình ở phía nam, còn các chi tộc của Giô-sép ở lại trong đất của họ ở phía bắc.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그것을 일곱 몫으로 나눌 것이다. 유다는 남쪽의 자기 지역에 머물고, 요셉의 집은 북쪽의 자기 지역에 머물 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 땅을 일곱 몫으로 나눌 것이다. 유다는 남쪽에 있는 자기 지역을 그대로 지키고, 요셉의 집안은 북쪽에 있는 자기 지역을 그대로 지킬 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 그 땅을 일곱 부분으로 나눌 것이다. 유다 지파는 남쪽에 있는 자기 땅에 그대로 있고, 요셉의 지파들은 북쪽에 있는 자기 땅에 그대로 있을 것이다.

pt.L: E eles a dividirão em sete partes. Judá ficará no seu território, ao sul, e a casa de José ficará no seu território, ao norte.
pt.B: Eles devem dividi-la em sete partes. Judá continuará no seu território, no sul, e a casa de José continuará no seu, no norte.
pt.R: Eles vão dividir a terra em sete partes. Judá vai continuar na sua própria terra, no sul, e as tribos de José vão continuar na terra delas, no norte.

decisions.choice: will stand: will remain, keep its place
decisions.reason: The verb "stand" here means to stay where one is. The land already given is not shared out again; the seven portions are drawn from what lies outside it.

decisions.choice: the house of Joseph: the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh
decisions.reason: Joseph's two sons became two tribes (Genesis 48:5; Joshua 14:4). Their land in the middle of the country is called the lot of the sons of Joseph in 16:1-4 and 17:14-18.

decisions.choice: on the south, on the north: Judah south of the hill country, Joseph north of it
decisions.reason: Judah's land lay in the south (chapter 15) and Joseph's in the center north of it (chapters 16-17). Benjamin's lot will fall in the strip between them (verse 11).

decisions.choice: Joseph's tribes
decisions.reason: Readable says "Joseph's tribes" for "the house of Joseph", since "house" here means descendants (m2).

source.text: וְאַתֶּ֞ם תִּכְתְּב֤וּ אֶת־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֔ים וַֽהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י הֵ֑נָּה וְיָרִ֨יתִי לָכֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, you will write the land, seven portions, and bring to me here, and I will cast for you a lot here before [the] face of Yahweh our God.

en.L: And you are to write up the land in seven portions and bring [it] to me here, and I will cast a lot for you here before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God.
en.B: You are to describe the land in seven portions and bring the description here to me. Then here, before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, I will cast lots for you.
en.R: Write down a description of the land in seven parts and bring it here to me. Then I will throw lots for you here in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God.

sw.L: Nanyi mtaiandika nchi katika mafungu saba na kuniletea hapa, nami nitawapigia kura hapa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu.
sw.B: Mtaeleza nchi katika mafungu saba, na kuniletea hapa maelezo hayo. Kisha hapa, mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, nitawapigia kura.
sw.R: Andikeni maelezo ya nchi katika sehemu saba, mniletee hapa. Kisha nitawapigia kura hapa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes describirán|vosotros describiréis}} la tierra en siete porciones y me [la] {{plural_you:traerán|traeréis}} aquí, y yo {{plural_you:les|os}} echaré suertes aquí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes describirán|Vosotros describiréis}} la tierra en siete porciones y me {{plural_you:traerán|traeréis}} aquí la descripción. Entonces aquí, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, yo {{plural_you:les|os}} echaré suertes.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escriban|Escribid}} una descripción de la tierra en siete partes y {{plural_you:tráiganmela|traédmela}} aquí. Entonces yo {{plural_you:les|os}} echaré suertes aquí, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios.

fr.L: Et vous, vous décrirez le pays en sept parts et vous [me] l’apporterez ici, et je jetterai pour vous le sort ici, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu.
fr.B: Vous décrirez le pays en sept parts et vous m’apporterez ici cette description. Puis ici, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, je tirerai au sort pour vous.
fr.R: Écrivez une description du pays en sept parties et apportez-la-moi ici. Ensuite, je tirerai au sort pour vous, ici, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu.

vi.L: Còn anh em hãy ghi chép xứ thành bảy phần và đem [về] cho tôi ở đây, và tôi sẽ bắt thăm cho anh em ở đây trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: Anh em hãy mô tả xứ thành bảy phần và đem bản mô tả về đây cho tôi. Rồi tại đây, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, tôi sẽ bắt thăm cho anh em.
vi.R: Hãy ghi lại mô tả về xứ chia làm bảy phần và đem về đây cho tôi. Rồi tôi sẽ bắt thăm cho anh em tại đây, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 그 땅을 일곱 몫으로 기록하여 [그것을] 여기 나에게 가져오너라. 그러면 내가 여기 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희를 위하여 제비를 뽑겠다.
ko.B: 너희는 그 땅을 일곱 몫으로 나누어 적고, 그 글을 여기 나에게 가져오너라. 그러면 내가 여기 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희를 위하여 제비를 뽑겠다.
ko.R: 그 땅을 일곱 부분으로 나누어 적고, 그것을 여기 나에게 가져오너라. 그러면 내가 여기 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희를 위하여 제비를 뽑겠다.

pt.L: E vocês descreverão a terra [em] sete partes e [a] trarão a mim aqui, e eu lançarei sortes para vocês aqui, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o nosso Deus.
pt.B: Vocês devem descrever a terra em sete partes e trazer a descrição aqui para mim. Então, aqui, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o nosso Deus, eu lançarei sortes para vocês.
pt.R: Descrevam por escrito a terra em sete partes e tragam essa descrição aqui para mim. Depois eu vou lançar sortes para vocês aqui, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o nosso Deus.

decisions.choice: and you: the people as a whole, addressed directly
decisions.reason: Joshua turns from the twenty-one men to the people with an emphatic "you". The men do the walking and writing, but the task belongs to the tribes who sent them.

decisions.choice: I will cast a lot: the shares are decided by lot
decisions.reason: Casting lots left the choice of which tribe received which portion to the LORD, as Moses had commanded (Numbers 26:55-56; 33:54; 34:13; Proverbs 16:33). How the lot was made is not described; it may have been stones or marked objects thrown or drawn.

decisions.choice: before the LORD our God: at the tent of meeting, in his presence
decisions.reason: The lots are cast at the place where the tent stands (verse 1), so the result is the LORD's decision, made in his presence (verses 8, 10; 19:51).

decisions.choice: [it]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "bring to me" has no object; Literal supplies "it" in brackets. Balanced says "the description".

decisions.choice: throw lots
decisions.reason: Readable uses "throw", a plainer word for "cast", which keeps the picture of the Hebrew verb.

decisions.choice: "echar suertes" for casting the lot, at every level
decisions.reason: "Echar suertes" is the plain Spanish phrase for casting lots, used through these chapters (18:8, 10). Done "before the LORD" at the tent, it shows the share-out as the LORD's own choice.

decisions.choice: lançar sortes diante do SENHOR (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (18:6, 8, 10; 19:51). The lot leaves the choice to the LORD, in his presence (m2, m3). "Lançar sortes" is the Portuguese phrase for it and cannot be read as "by luck", so every level keeps it, where Numbers 26:55 says "sorteio" for the noun; Literal too writes the plural "sortes", the form the idiom takes, for the Hebrew singular. "Diante do SENHOR" keeps the place of the act at every level, where the English Readable says "in front of".

source.text: כִּ֠י אֵֽין־חֵ֤לֶק לַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־כְהֻנַּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה נַחֲלָת֑וֹ וְגָ֡ד וּרְאוּבֵ֡ן וַחֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֤בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For not [is there] a portion for the Levites in your midst, for [the] priesthood of Yahweh [is] his inheritance; and Gad and Reuben and half [the] tribe of the Manasseh have taken their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which gave to them Moses, [the] servant of Yahweh.

en.L: For the Levites have no portion among you, for the priesthood of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] their inheritance; and Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan to the east, which Moses the slave of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them."
en.B: The Levites have no portion among you, because the priesthood of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh already have their inheritance east of the Jordan, the land that Moses the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them."
en.R: The Levites will not get a share of land among you, because serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as priests is their share. And the tribes of Gad and Reuben and half of the tribe of Manasseh already have their land on the east side of the Jordan. Moses, the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, gave it to them."

sw.L: Kwa maana Walawi hawana fungu katikati yenu, kwa maana ukuhani wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndio] urithi wao; na Gadi na Reubeni na nusu ya kabila la Manase wamepokea urithi wao ng'ambo ya Yordani upande wa mashariki, ambao Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa."
sw.B: Walawi hawana fungu kati yenu, kwa sababu ukuhani wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndio urithi wao. Nao Gadi, Reubeni na nusu ya kabila la Manase tayari wana urithi wao upande wa mashariki wa Yordani, nchi ambayo Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa."
sw.R: Walawi hawatapata sehemu ya nchi kati yenu, kwa sababu kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama makuhani ndilo fungu lao. Nayo makabila ya Gadi na Reubeni na nusu ya kabila la Manase tayari wana nchi yao upande wa mashariki wa Yordani. Musa, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliwapa nchi hiyo."

es.L: Porque los levitas no [tienen] parte en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, pues el sacerdocio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] su heredad; y Gad y Rubén y la media tribu de Manasés han recibido su heredad al otro lado del Jordán, al oriente, la que les dio Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.B: Los levitas no tienen porción entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque el sacerdocio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es su heredad. Y Gad, Rubén y la media tribu de Manasés ya tienen su heredad al este del Jordán, la tierra que les dio Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.R: Los levitas no recibirán una parte de la tierra entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque servir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como sacerdotes es su parte. Y las tribus de Gad y Rubén y la mitad de la tribu de Manasés ya tienen su tierra al lado este del Jordán. Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, se la dio».

fr.L: Car il n’y a pas de part pour les Lévites au milieu de vous, car le sacerdoce {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] leur héritage ; et Gad, et Ruben, et la moitié de la tribu de Manassé ont reçu leur héritage au-delà du Jourdain, vers l’orient, celui que leur a donné Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Les Lévites n’ont pas de part au milieu de vous, car le sacerdoce {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est leur héritage. Quant à Gad, à Ruben et à la demi-tribu de Manassé, ils ont déjà reçu leur héritage à l’est du Jourdain, le pays que leur a donné Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Les Lévites n’auront pas de terre parmi vous, parce que servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme prêtres, voilà leur part. Et les tribus de Gad et de Ruben, avec la moitié de la tribu de Manassé, ont déjà leur terre à l’est du Jourdain. C’est Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui la leur a donnée. »

vi.L: Vì người Lê-vi không có phần giữa anh em, vì chức tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] sản nghiệp của họ; còn Gát, Ru-bên và nửa chi tộc Ma-na-se đã nhận sản nghiệp của mình ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh về phía đông, mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã ban cho họ."
vi.B: Người Lê-vi không có phần giữa anh em, vì chức tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là sản nghiệp của họ. Còn Gát, Ru-bên và nửa chi tộc Ma-na-se đã có sản nghiệp của mình ở phía đông sông Giô-đanh, là đất Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã ban cho họ."
vi.R: Người Lê-vi sẽ không được phần đất nào giữa anh em, vì việc làm thầy tế lễ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là phần của họ. Còn các chi tộc Gát, Ru-bên và nửa chi tộc Ma-na-se đã có đất của mình ở phía đông sông Giô-đanh rồi. Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã ban đất ấy cho họ."

ko.L: 레위인들은 너희 가운데 몫이 없으니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장 직분이 그들의 유산이기 때문이다. 그리고 갓과 르우벤과 므낫세 반 지파는 요단 건너편 동쪽에서 그들의 유산을 받았으니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 그들에게 준 것이다."
ko.B: 레위인들은 너희 가운데서 몫을 받지 않는다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장 직분이 그들의 유산이기 때문이다. 그리고 갓과 르우벤과 므낫세 반 지파는 이미 요단강 동쪽에서 유산을 받았다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 그들에게 준 땅이다."
ko.R: 레위인들은 너희 가운데서 땅을 받지 않을 것이다. 제사장으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 일이 그들의 몫이기 때문이다. 그리고 갓 지파와 르우벤 지파와 므낫세 지파의 절반은 이미 요단강 동쪽에서 자기 땅을 받았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 그 땅을 그들에게 주었다."

pt.L: Porque os levitas não têm parte no meio de vocês, pois o sacerdócio {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [é] a herança deles; e Gade, e Rúben, e a meia tribo de Manassés receberam a sua herança além do Jordão, a leste, a qual Moisés, o escravo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, lhes deu."
pt.B: Os levitas não têm parte entre vocês, porque o sacerdócio {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} é a herança deles. E Gade, Rúben e a meia tribo de Manassés já receberam a sua herança a leste do Jordão, a terra que Moisés, o servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, lhes deu."
pt.R: Os levitas não vão receber uma parte da terra entre vocês, porque a parte deles é servir {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} como sacerdotes. E as tribos de Gade e de Rúben e a metade da tribo de Manassés já têm a sua terra do lado leste do Jordão. Moisés, o servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, deu essa terra a elas."

decisions.choice: for: the reason only seven portions are needed
decisions.reason: Verse 7 explains the number seven in verses 5-6. Of the twelve shares, Levi has none, two and a half tribes are settled east of the Jordan, and Judah and Joseph already have their land. Seven remain.

decisions.choice: the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance
decisions.reason: Levi received no tribal land. Its share was the service of the LORD and what came with it (Numbers 18:20-24; Deuteronomy 18:1-2). In 13:14 their inheritance is the offerings, in 13:33 the LORD himself; here it is the priesthood. Levi was given towns to live in among the other tribes (chapter 21).

decisions.choice: his inheritance: the tribe's inheritance
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his", with Levi spoken of as one tribe after the plural "Levites"; the sense is "their".

decisions.choice: beyond the Jordan eastward: east of the river
decisions.reason: "Beyond the Jordan" can mean either side, depending on where the speaker stands; "eastward" makes plain that here it is the east side, seen from Shiloh (13:8; 1:15).

decisions.choice: Moses the servant of the LORD: his title, as in 1:1
decisions.reason: As in 1:1 and 13:8, the title marks Moses as the one who belonged to the LORD and acted for him. His gift of land east of the Jordan stands (Numbers 32:33).

decisions.choice: slave (Literal) / servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1:1: Literal shows the hard sense of the word with "slave", and Balanced and Readable use "servant", the usual sense of the title.

decisions.choice: their inheritance
decisions.reason: Every level writes "their" for the Hebrew "his" (m3), since English would otherwise seem to speak of the LORD's inheritance.

decisions.choice: serving the LORD as priests is their share
decisions.reason: Readable says what the priesthood is, a work of service, so young readers do not take it as a place.

decisions.choice: "le serviteur du SEIGNEUR" at Literal too
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for Moses' title and as recorded at 13:8; the English Literal has "slave".

decisions.choice: a herança deles (every level)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "his inheritance" means the tribe's (m3). Portuguese "a sua herança" after "o sacerdócio do SENHOR" could be read as the LORD's, so every level says "deles", as the English says "their" (r-en-2).

source.text: וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ אֶת־הַהֹלְכִים֩ לִכְתֹּ֨ב אֶת־הָאָ֜רֶץ לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ בָאָ֜רֶץ וְכִתְב֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וְשׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔י וּ֠פֹה אַשְׁלִ֨יךְ לָכֶ֥ם גּוֹרָ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose the men and went, and commanded Joshua those going to write the land, saying, Go and walk about in the land and write it and return to me, and here I will cast for you a lot before Yahweh in Shiloh.

en.L: And the men arose and went; and Joshua commanded those who were going to write up the land, saying, "Go and walk about in the land and write it up, and return to me; and here I will cast a lot for you before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Shiloh."
en.B: So the men set out. As they were going to describe the land, Joshua gave them this command: "Go through the land, write a description of it, and come back to me. Then here in Shiloh, before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will cast lots for you."
en.R: So the men got ready to go. As they left to describe the land, Joshua told them, "Go and travel through the land. Write down what it is like. Then come back to me. I will throw lots for you here at Shiloh in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

sw.L: Na watu wakaondoka wakaenda; na Yoshua akawaamuru wale waliokuwa wakienda kuiandika nchi, akisema, "Nendeni mkatembee katika nchi na kuiandika, mrudi kwangu; nami nitawapigia kura hapa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Shilo."
sw.B: Basi watu wakaondoka. Walipokuwa wakienda kuieleza nchi, Yoshua aliwaagiza hivi: "Nendeni mkazunguke katika nchi, mwandike maelezo yake, mrudi kwangu. Kisha hapa Shilo, mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawapigia kura."
sw.R: Basi watu wakajiandaa kwenda. Walipokuwa wakiondoka kwenda kuieleza nchi, Yoshua aliwaambia, "Nendeni msafiri katika nchi. Andikeni jinsi ilivyo. Kisha mrudi kwangu. Nitawapigia kura hapa Shilo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

es.L: Y los hombres se levantaron y fueron; y Josué mandó a los que iban a describir la tierra, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:recorran|recorred}} la tierra y {{plural_you:descríbanla|describidla}}, y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a mí; y aquí {{plural_you:les|os}} echaré suertes delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Silo».
es.B: Los hombres se pusieron en camino. Cuando iban a describir la tierra, Josué les dio esta orden: «{{plural_you:Recorran|Recorred}} la tierra, {{plural_you:escriban|escribid}} una descripción de ella y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a mí. Entonces aquí en Silo, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} echaré suertes».
es.R: Los hombres se prepararon para salir. Cuando se iban a describir la tierra, Josué les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:recorran|recorred}} la tierra. {{plural_you:Escriban|Escribid}} cómo es. Después {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a mí. Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} echaré suertes aquí en Silo, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et les hommes se levèrent et s’en allèrent ; et Josué ordonna à ceux qui allaient décrire le pays, en disant : « Allez, parcourez le pays et décrivez-le, et revenez vers moi ; et ici je jetterai pour vous le sort devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Silo. »
fr.B: Les hommes se mirent donc en route. Comme ils partaient décrire le pays, Josué leur donna cet ordre : « Allez parcourir le pays, faites-en la description et revenez vers moi. Ensuite, ici à Silo, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je tirerai au sort pour vous. »
fr.R: Les hommes se sont donc préparés à partir. Au moment où ils s’en allaient décrire le pays, Josué leur a dit : « Allez parcourir le pays. Écrivez comment il est. Puis revenez vers moi. Je tirerai au sort pour vous ici, à Silo, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

vi.L: Những người ấy đứng dậy và đi; Giô-suê truyền cho những người đi ghi chép xứ rằng: "Hãy đi khắp xứ, ghi chép nó, rồi trở về với tôi; tại đây tôi sẽ bắt thăm cho anh em trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở Si-lô."
vi.B: Vậy những người ấy lên đường. Khi họ sắp đi mô tả xứ, Giô-suê truyền cho họ: "Hãy đi khắp xứ, ghi lại mô tả về xứ, rồi trở về với tôi. Rồi tại Si-lô này, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi sẽ bắt thăm cho anh em."
vi.R: Vậy những người ấy chuẩn bị lên đường. Khi họ ra đi để mô tả xứ, Giô-suê dặn họ: "Hãy đi khắp xứ. Hãy ghi lại xứ ấy như thế nào. Rồi trở về với tôi. Tôi sẽ bắt thăm cho anh em ở Si-lô này, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 그리고 그 사람들이 일어나 갔다. 그리고 여호수아가 그 땅을 기록하러 가는 자들에게 명령하여 말했다. "가서 그 땅을 두루 다니며 그것을 기록하고 나에게 돌아오너라. 그러면 내가 여기 실로에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희를 위하여 제비를 뽑겠다."
ko.B: 그래서 그 사람들은 길을 떠났다. 그 땅을 글로 적으러 가는 그들에게 여호수아가 이렇게 명령했다. "가서 그 땅을 두루 다니며 글로 적은 다음, 나에게 돌아오너라. 그러면 내가 여기 실로에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희를 위하여 제비를 뽑겠다."
ko.R: 그래서 그 사람들은 떠날 준비를 했다. 그 땅이 어떤지 적으러 떠나는 그들에게 여호수아가 말했다. "가서 그 땅을 두루 다녀 보아라. 그 땅이 어떤지 적어라. 그러고 나서 나에게 돌아오너라. 내가 여기 실로에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희를 위하여 제비를 뽑겠다."

pt.L: E os homens se levantaram e foram; e Josué ordenou aos que iam descrever a terra, dizendo: "Vão, e percorram a terra, e descrevam-na, e voltem a mim; e aqui eu lançarei sortes para vocês diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Siló."
pt.B: Os homens partiram. Quando eles estavam saindo para descrever a terra, Josué lhes deu esta ordem: "Vão, percorram a terra, descrevam-na por escrito e voltem até mim. Então, aqui em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, eu lançarei sortes para vocês."
pt.R: Então os homens se prepararam para ir. Quando eles estavam saindo para descrever a terra, Josué disse a eles: "Vão e percorram a terra. Escrevam como ela é. Depois voltem até mim. Aqui em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, eu vou lançar sortes para vocês."

decisions.choice: arose and went ... and commanded: Joshua's charge as they set out
decisions.reason: The verbs follow one another in the usual way of Hebrew narrative, but the charge belongs to the moment of leaving: Joshua instructs "those who were going". The words repeat the plan of verses 4 and 6 as a command to the men themselves.

decisions.choice: walk about in the land and write it: survey and record
decisions.reason: As in verse 4.

decisions.choice: before the LORD in Shiloh
decisions.reason: The lot will be cast where the tent of meeting now stands (verse 1), so the division is made in the LORD's presence (verse 6).

decisions.choice: As they were going ..., Joshua gave them this command
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "as they were going" first, which shows that Joshua spoke when the men were leaving (m1).

source.text: וַיֵּלְכ֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וַיִּכְתְּב֧וּהָ לֶֽעָרִ֛ים לְשִׁבְעָ֥ה חֲלָקִ֖ים עַל־סֵ֑פֶר וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁלֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And went the men and passed through the land and wrote it by cities into seven portions on a scroll, and came to Joshua, to the camp [at] Shiloh.

en.L: And the men went and passed through the land and wrote it up by towns in seven portions in a scroll, and they came to Joshua, to the camp [at] Shiloh.
en.B: The men went and traveled through the land. They described it town by town in seven portions, writing it in a scroll, and came back to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
en.R: So the men went and traveled through the land. They wrote down a list of its towns in seven parts on a scroll. Then they came back to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.

sw.L: Na watu wakaenda wakapita katika nchi, wakaiandika kwa miji katika mafungu saba katika kitabu, wakaja kwa Yoshua, kambini [huko] Shilo.
sw.B: Watu walienda wakasafiri katika nchi. Waliieleza mji kwa mji katika mafungu saba, wakiandika katika kitabu, wakarudi kwa Yoshua kambini huko Shilo.
sw.R: Basi watu walienda wakasafiri katika nchi. Waliandika orodha ya miji yake katika sehemu saba kwenye kitabu. Kisha wakarudi kwa Yoshua kambini huko Shilo.

es.L: Y los hombres fueron y pasaron por la tierra y la describieron por ciudades en siete porciones en un rollo, y vinieron a Josué, al campamento [en] Silo.
es.B: Los hombres fueron y recorrieron la tierra. La describieron población por población en siete porciones, escribiéndolo en un rollo, y volvieron a Josué al campamento en Silo.
es.R: Así que los hombres fueron y recorrieron la tierra. Escribieron en un rollo una lista de sus pueblos, en siete partes. Después volvieron a Josué, al campamento de Silo.

fr.L: Et les hommes allèrent, et passèrent dans le pays, et le décrivirent par villes en sept parts dans un livre, et ils vinrent vers Josué, au camp [à] Silo.
fr.B: Les hommes partirent et parcoururent le pays. Ils le décrivirent ville par ville en sept parts, par écrit dans un rouleau, et revinrent auprès de Josué, au camp de Silo.
fr.R: Les hommes sont donc partis et ont parcouru le pays. Ils ont écrit sur un rouleau la liste de ses villes, en sept parties. Puis ils sont revenus auprès de Josué, au camp de Silo.

vi.L: Những người ấy đi, băng qua xứ, ghi chép nó theo từng thành thành bảy phần trong một cuộn sách, rồi trở về với Giô-suê, tại trại [ở] Si-lô.
vi.B: Những người ấy đi khắp xứ. Họ mô tả xứ theo từng thị trấn, chia làm bảy phần, ghi vào một cuộn sách, rồi trở về với Giô-suê tại trại ở Si-lô.
vi.R: Vậy những người ấy đi khắp xứ. Họ ghi danh sách các thị trấn của xứ thành bảy phần trên một cuộn sách. Rồi họ trở về với Giô-suê tại trại ở Si-lô.

ko.L: 그리고 그 사람들이 가서 그 땅을 두루 다니며 성읍별로 일곱 몫으로 책에 기록하고, 실로의 진영으로 여호수아에게 왔다.
ko.B: 그 사람들은 가서 그 땅을 두루 다녔다. 그들은 그 땅을 성읍별로 일곱 몫으로 나누어 두루마리에 적고, 실로의 진영에 있는 여호수아에게 돌아왔다.
ko.R: 그래서 그 사람들은 가서 그 땅을 두루 다녔다. 그들은 그 땅의 성읍들을 일곱 부분으로 나누어 두루마리에 적었다. 그러고 나서 실로의 진영에 있는 여호수아에게 돌아왔다.

pt.L: E os homens foram e passaram pela terra, e a descreveram por cidades, em sete partes, num rolo, e vieram a Josué, ao acampamento [em] Siló.
pt.B: Os homens foram e percorreram a terra. Eles a descreveram cidade por cidade, em sete partes, escrevendo tudo num rolo, e voltaram a Josué, no acampamento em Siló.
pt.R: Os homens foram e percorreram a terra. Num rolo, eles escreveram uma lista das cidades, em sete partes. Depois voltaram até Josué, no acampamento em Siló.

decisions.choice: by towns: a record arranged by towns
decisions.reason: The written account named the towns of each region. The town lists of chapters 18-19 (verses 21-28 here) give an idea of what it held.

decisions.choice: a scroll: a written document
decisions.reason: The word means a writing of any kind, a scroll or a document (Exodus 17:14; Deuteronomy 24:1). Here it is the written survey on which the lots were cast.

decisions.choice: the camp at Shiloh: Israel was still living in a camp
decisions.reason: Israel's camp had been at Gilgal (10:43; 14:6). Now the people and the tent are gathered at Shiloh, and the camp is there until the tribes go to their land.

decisions.choice: town
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word covers any walled or settled place, large or small. Balanced and Readable use "town", which fits the size of most of them. The word is "cities" in the totals of verses 24 and 28 at Literal.

decisions.choice: "un livre" (L), "un rouleau" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sefer is any written document. Literal keeps the old French sense of "livre", a written record; Balanced and Readable say what it looked like, a scroll, as the English does.

decisions.choice: cidades (every level); um rolo
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as Numbers 35:2 sets it in Portuguese: Portuguese has no plain word between "cidade" and "vila" for a walled place of any size, and "vila" reads as a village or a district, so every level says "cidades" where the English Balanced and Readable say "towns" (r-en-1). The written survey is "um rolo" (m2); "livro" would suggest a bound book.

source.text: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֩ לָהֶ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ גּוֹרָ֛ל בְּשִׁלֹ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְחַלֶּק־שָׁ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ אֶת־הָאָ֛רֶץ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And cast for them Joshua a lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, and divided there Joshua the land to [the] sons of Israel according to their divisions.

en.L: And Joshua cast a lot for them in Shiloh before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and there Joshua divided the land to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel according to their divisions.
en.B: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and there he divided the land among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, giving each tribe its portion.
en.R: Joshua threw lots for them at Shiloh in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. In this way he divided the land among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Each tribe got its own part.

sw.L: Na Yoshua akawapigia kura huko Shilo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na huko Yoshua akawagawia wana wa Israeli nchi kufuatana na migawanyo yao.
sw.B: Yoshua aliwapigia kura huko Shilo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na huko akaigawa nchi kati ya Waisraeli, akilipa kila kabila fungu lake.
sw.R: Yoshua aliwapigia kura huko Shilo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa njia hiyo aliigawa nchi kati ya Waisraeli. Kila kabila lilipata sehemu yake.

es.L: Y Josué les echó suertes en Silo delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y allí repartió Josué la tierra a los hijos de Israel conforme a sus divisiones.
es.B: Josué les echó suertes en Silo, en presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y allí repartió la tierra entre los israelitas, dando a cada tribu su porción.
es.R: Josué les echó suertes en Silo, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Así repartió la tierra entre los israelitas. Cada tribu recibió su propia parte.

fr.L: Et Josué jeta pour eux le sort à Silo devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et là Josué partagea le pays aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël selon leurs divisions.
fr.B: Josué tira au sort pour eux à Silo, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et là il partagea le pays entre les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, en donnant à chaque tribu sa part.
fr.R: Josué a tiré au sort pour eux à Silo, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a partagé ainsi le pays entre les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Chaque tribu a reçu sa part.

vi.L: Giô-suê bắt thăm cho họ tại Si-lô trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tại đó Giô-suê chia xứ cho con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên theo các phần của họ.
vi.B: Giô-suê bắt thăm cho họ tại Si-lô trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tại đó ông chia xứ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, mỗi chi tộc một phần.
vi.R: Giô-suê bắt thăm cho họ tại Si-lô, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Bằng cách ấy ông chia đất cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Mỗi chi tộc được phần riêng của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 실로에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 그들을 위하여 제비를 뽑았다. 그리고 거기에서 여호수아가 그 땅을 이스라엘 자손에게 그들의 몫대로 나누었다.
ko.B: 여호수아는 실로에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 그들을 위하여 제비를 뽑았다. 그리고 거기에서 그 땅을 이스라엘 자손에게 지파별로 나누어 주었다.
ko.R: 여호수아는 실로에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 그들을 위하여 제비를 뽑았다. 이렇게 하여 그는 그 땅을 이스라엘 백성에게 나누어 주었다. 지파마다 자기 몫을 받았다.

pt.L: E Josué lançou sortes para eles em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e ali Josué repartiu a terra aos filhos de Israel segundo as suas divisões.
pt.B: Josué lançou sortes para eles em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e ali repartiu a terra entre os israelitas, dando a cada tribo a sua parte.
pt.R: Josué lançou sortes para eles em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Assim ele dividiu a terra entre os israelitas. Cada tribo recebeu a sua própria parte.

decisions.choice: according to their divisions: by the portions set for each tribe
decisions.reason: The word is related to the verb "divide" and the noun "portion" in verses 5-6. Each of the seven tribes received the portion its lot fell on (11:23; 12:7).

decisions.choice: cast ... and divided: a summary of what chapters 18-19 tell in detail
decisions.reason: The verse sums up the whole process. The lots for each tribe follow, beginning with Benjamin (verse 11) and ending with Dan (19:40-48); 19:51 closes the account at the same place, Shiloh.

decisions.choice: giving each tribe its portion / Each tribe got its own part
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "according to their divisions" means (m1).

source.text: וַיַּ֗עַל גּוֹרַ֛ל מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיֵּצֵא֙ גְּב֣וּל גּֽוֹרָלָ֔ם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: And came up [the] lot of [the] tribe of [the] sons of Benjamin by their clans, and went out [the] territory of their lot between [the] sons of Judah and between [the] sons of Joseph.

en.L: And the lot of the tribe of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Benjamin came up by their clans, and the territory of their lot went out between the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Joseph.
en.B: The first lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan. The territory that fell to them lay between the people of Judah and the people of Joseph.
en.R: The first lot was drawn for the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan. The land they got lay between the land of Judah and the land of Joseph's tribes.

sw.L: Na kura ya kabila la wana wa Benyamini ikatoka kufuatana na koo zao, na eneo la kura yao likatokea kati ya wana wa Yuda na wana wa Yusufu.
sw.B: Kura ya kwanza ilitoka kwa kabila la Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo. Eneo lililowaangukia lilikuwa kati ya watu wa Yuda na watu wa Yusufu.
sw.R: Kura ya kwanza ilipigwa kwa ajili ya kabila la Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo. Nchi waliyopata ilikuwa kati ya nchi ya Yuda na nchi ya makabila ya Yusufu.

es.L: Y salió la suerte de la tribu de los hijos de Benjamín conforme a sus clanes, y el territorio de su suerte salió entre los hijos de Judá y los hijos de José.
es.B: La primera suerte salió para la tribu de Benjamín, clan por clan. El territorio que les tocó quedaba entre la gente de Judá y la gente de José.
es.R: La primera suerte se echó para la tribu de Benjamín, clan por clan. La tierra que recibieron quedaba entre la tierra de Judá y la tierra de las tribus de José.

fr.L: Et le sort de la tribu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Benjamin monta selon leurs clans, et le territoire de leur sort sortit entre les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Joseph.
fr.B: Le premier sort tomba sur la tribu de Benjamin, clan par clan. Le territoire qui lui échut se trouvait entre les gens de Juda et les gens de Joseph.
fr.R: Le premier tirage au sort a été pour la tribu de Benjamin, clan par clan. Le pays qu’ils ont reçu se trouvait entre le pays de Juda et celui des tribus de Joseph.

vi.L: Thăm của chi tộc con cháu Bên-gia-min theo các gia tộc của họ trúng ra, và địa phận theo thăm của họ nằm giữa con cháu Giu-đa và con cháu Giô-sép.
vi.B: Thăm thứ nhất trúng chi tộc Bên-gia-min, theo từng gia tộc. Địa phận họ bắt thăm được nằm giữa người Giu-đa và người Giô-sép.
vi.R: Thăm thứ nhất được bắt cho chi tộc Bên-gia-min, theo từng gia tộc. Phần đất họ nhận nằm giữa đất Giu-đa và đất của các chi tộc Giô-sép.

ko.L: 그리고 베냐민 자손 지파의 제비가 그들의 종족대로 올라왔다. 그리고 그들의 제비의 지역은 유다 자손과 요셉 자손 사이로 나왔다.
ko.B: 첫째 제비는 베냐민 지파에게 종족별로 나왔다. 그들이 제비 뽑아 받은 지역은 유다 자손과 요셉 자손 사이에 있었다.
ko.R: 첫째 제비는 베냐민 지파에게 집안별로 뽑혔다. 그들이 받은 땅은 유다 지파의 땅과 요셉 지파들의 땅 사이에 있었다.

pt.L: E subiu a sorte da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, segundo os seus clãs, e o território da sua sorte saiu entre os filhos de Judá e os filhos de José.
pt.B: O primeiro sorteio saiu para a tribo de Benjamim, clã por clã. O território que coube a eles ficava entre o povo de Judá e o povo de José.
pt.R: O primeiro sorteio foi para a tribo de Benjamim, clã por clã. A terra que eles receberam ficava entre a terra de Judá e a terra das tribos de José.

decisions.choice: the lot came up: the lot fell to Benjamin
decisions.reason: The lot is said to "come up", perhaps because it was drawn up out of a container or a fold of cloth (19:1, 10; Leviticus 16:9). Benjamin's is the first of the seven lots cast at Shiloh.

decisions.choice: between Judah and Joseph: a narrow strip across the hills
decisions.reason: Benjamin's land ran from the Jordan westward across the hill country, with Judah's border on its south (15:5-11) and Joseph's, that is Ephraim's, on its north (16:1-3). Its northern line repeats the southern line of Joseph and its southern line repeats the northern line of Judah, traced the other way.

decisions.choice: the territory of their lot: the land the lot gave them
decisions.reason: "Territory" is the same word as "border" in verses 12-20; it means a boundary or the land within it. "Their lot" is the land that fell to them by lot.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Benjamin
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the tribe of the sons of Benjamin"; Balanced and Readable say "the tribe of Benjamin", which means the same in English. "The sons of Judah" and "of Joseph" become "the people of" (B) and "the land of" (R).

decisions.choice: The first lot
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "first", since the seven lots follow one another and this is the first of them (m1).

decisions.choice: subiu a sorte (L); o sorteio saiu para (B), o sorteio foi para (R); segundo os seus clãs (L), clã por clã (B, R)
decisions.reason: For chapters 18-19 (also 19:1, 10, 17, 24, 32, 40). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the lot that "comes up" (m1); Balanced and Readable say "o sorteio", the plain word 13:6 and 15:1 use at those levels, which a modern reader cannot take for luck: "saiu" at Balanced, the ordinary verb for a draw, and "foi para" at Readable, as the English Readable says "was drawn". The verb "lançar sortes" (verse 6) keeps the old noun. "Os filhos de Benjamim" (L) needs no gender setting, since "filhos" already includes daughters.

source.text: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֧ם הַגְּב֛וּל לִפְאַ֥ת צָפ֖וֹנָה מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּבוּל֩ אֶל־כֶּ֨תֶף יְרִיח֜וֹ מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְעָלָ֤ה בָהָר֙ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיוּ֙ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו מִדְבַּ֖רָה בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And was for them the border on [the] side northward from the Jordan, and goes up the border to [the] slope of Jericho from [the] north, and goes up in the hill country westward, and are its goings out [at the] wilderness of Beth-aven.

en.L: And their border on the north side was from the Jordan; and the border goes up to the slope of Jericho on the north, and goes up through the hill country westward, and its end is at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
en.B: On the north side their border started at the Jordan. It goes up the slope north of Jericho, climbs westward through the hill country and comes out at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
en.R: Their northern border started at the Jordan River. From there it went up the hillside north of Jericho. Then it went west up into the hill country and came out at the desert near Beth-aven.

sw.L: Na mpaka wao upande wa kaskazini ulikuwa kutoka Yordani; na mpaka unapanda hadi mteremko wa Yeriko upande wa kaskazini, na kupanda kupitia nchi ya milima kuelekea magharibi, na mwisho wake ni nyika ya Beth-aveni.
sw.B: Upande wa kaskazini mpaka wao ulianzia Yordani. Unapanda mteremko ulio kaskazini mwa Yeriko, unapanda kuelekea magharibi kupitia nchi ya milima, na kutokea kwenye nyika ya Beth-aveni.
sw.R: Mpaka wao wa kaskazini ulianzia Mto Yordani. Kutoka hapo ulipanda mteremko ulio kaskazini mwa Yeriko. Kisha ukaelekea magharibi, ukapanda kuingia nchi ya milima, ukatokea jangwani karibu na Beth-aveni.

es.L: Y su frontera por el lado norte fue desde el Jordán; y sube la frontera a la ladera de Jericó por el norte, y sube por la región montañosa al occidente, y sus salidas están en el desierto de Bet-avén.
es.B: Por el lado norte, su frontera empezaba en el Jordán. Sube por la ladera al norte de Jericó, asciende al occidente por la región montañosa y sale al desierto de Bet-avén.
es.R: Su frontera norte empezaba en el río Jordán. Desde allí subía por la ladera al norte de Jericó. Luego iba al oeste, subiendo a la región montañosa, y salía al desierto cerca de Bet-avén.

fr.L: Et leur frontière, du côté du nord, fut depuis le Jourdain ; et la frontière monte vers le flanc de Jéricho au nord, et monte dans la montagne vers l’occident, et ses issues sont au désert de Beth-Aven.
fr.B: Au nord, leur frontière partait du Jourdain. Elle monte le long du versant nord de Jéricho, gravit la région montagneuse vers l’ouest et aboutit au désert de Beth-Aven.
fr.R: Leur frontière nord commençait au Jourdain. De là, elle montait sur la colline au nord de Jéricho. Puis elle montait vers l’ouest dans la région montagneuse et arrivait au désert près de Beth-Aven.

vi.L: Ranh giới của họ ở phía bắc là từ sông Giô-đanh; ranh giới đi lên sườn Giê-ri-cô ở phía bắc, đi lên qua miền núi về phía tây, và cuối của nó là ở đồng hoang Bết-A-ven.
vi.B: Ở phía bắc, ranh giới của họ bắt đầu từ sông Giô-đanh. Nó đi lên sườn đồi phía bắc Giê-ri-cô, leo về phía tây qua miền núi, và ra đến đồng hoang Bết-A-ven.
vi.R: Ranh giới phía bắc của họ bắt đầu ở sông Giô-đanh. Từ đó nó đi lên sườn đồi phía bắc Giê-ri-cô. Rồi nó đi về phía tây, lên miền núi, và ra đến hoang mạc gần Bết-A-ven.

ko.L: 그리고 북쪽 편 그들의 경계는 요단에서부터였다. 그리고 경계는 북쪽으로 여리고 비탈로 올라가서 서쪽으로 산지를 거쳐 올라가고, 그 끝은 벧아웬 광야이다.
ko.B: 북쪽 경계는 요단강에서 시작된다. 경계는 여리고 북쪽 비탈로 올라가서 서쪽으로 산지를 지나 올라가고, 벧아웬 광야에 이른다.
ko.R: 그들의 북쪽 경계는 요단강에서 시작되었다. 거기에서 경계는 여리고 북쪽의 산비탈로 올라갔다. 그리고 서쪽 산지로 올라가서 벧아웬 근처의 광야에 이르렀다.

pt.L: E a fronteira deles, do lado norte, foi desde o Jordão; e a fronteira sobe até a encosta de Jericó, ao norte, e sobe pela região montanhosa para o oeste, e o seu extremo é no deserto de Bete-Áven.
pt.B: Do lado norte, a fronteira deles começa no Jordão. Ela sobe pela encosta ao norte de Jericó, segue para o oeste pela região montanhosa e chega ao deserto de Bete-Áven.
pt.R: A fronteira norte deles começava no rio Jordão. Dali ela subia pela encosta ao norte de Jericó. Depois seguia para o oeste, subindo a região montanhosa, e chegava ao deserto perto de Bete-Áven.

decisions.choice: goes up ... are its goings out: a description of the line as it runs
decisions.reason: After the first verb, the border is traced with a chain of verbs in a form that describes how something regularly is or goes. The line is followed as if walking it, from the Jordan westward. The same way of describing a border is used in 15:2-12 and Numbers 34:3-12.

decisions.choice: the slope of Jericho: the rising ground behind the town
decisions.reason: The word means "shoulder", the side of a ridge or hill (Numbers 34:11). The border climbs from the Jordan plain up the slopes north of Jericho into the hills.

decisions.choice: its goings out: the point the border reaches, its end
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:4, the plural word means where a border goes out to, its end or farthest reach. Here it marks the western end of this stretch.

decisions.choice: they are: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text (ketiv) read "it is", in the singular; the reading the scribes marked (qere), followed here, is "they are", agreeing with the plural "its goings out". The meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: the wilderness of Beth-aven: dry land near Bethel
decisions.reason: Beth-aven lay east of Bethel near Ai (7:2; 1 Samuel 13:5). Its wilderness is the dry, rough land falling away toward the Jordan valley. Hosea later used the name, which can be read "house of wickedness", as a mocking name for Bethel (Hosea 4:15; 10:5).

decisions.choice: goes up ... is (present tense)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use the present tense for the chain of verbs, which describe how the border runs (m1). Readable tells the line in the past tense, as part of the story of the lot, which young readers follow more easily; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the desert near Beth-aven
decisions.reason: Readable uses "desert" for the wilderness, as in Numbers 34:3.

decisions.choice: a fronteira sobe ... passa ... desce ... o seu extremo é (L, B, present); subia ... seguia ... terminava (R, imperfect)
decisions.reason: For the boundary lists of chapters 18-19. The chain of verbs describes how the line runs (m1). Literal and Balanced use the present, as the English does; Literal keeps "o seu extremo é" for "its goings out" (m3), as Numbers 34:4 has "o seu extremo será". Readable tells the line in the past, as the English Readable does, but in the imperfect ("subia", "seguia"), the Portuguese tense for describing how something lay; the pretérito perfeito "subiu" would make the border sound as if it moved.

decisions.choice: a encosta (every level); a região montanhosa
decisions.reason: The "shoulder" of a hill is its slope (m2); "encosta" is the Portuguese word, kept at every level and in verses 13-19. "A região montanhosa" is the hill country, as the Pentateuch has it in Portuguese.

source.text: וְעָבַר֩ מִשָּׁ֨ם הַגְּב֜וּל ל֗וּזָה אֶל־כֶּ֤תֶף ל֨וּזָה֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה הִ֖יא בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַל־הָהָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר מִנֶּ֥גֶב לְבֵית־חֹר֖וֹן תַּחְתּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And passes on from there the border to Luz, to [the] slope of Luz southward, that [is] Bethel, and goes down the border [to] Ataroth-addar, on the hill which [is] south of Beth-horon [the] lower.

en.L: And the border passes on from there toward Luz, to the slope of Luz on the south, that [is] Bethel; and the border goes down to Ataroth-addar, on the hill that [is] south of Lower Beth-horon.
en.B: From there the border passes on toward Luz, along the southern slope of Luz (that is, Bethel), and goes down to Ataroth-addar, on the hill that lies south of Lower Beth-horon.
en.R: From there the border went on to Luz, which is Bethel. It passed along the hillside south of the town. Then it went down to Ataroth-addar, which is on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.

sw.L: Na mpaka unapita kutoka huko kuelekea Luzu, hadi mteremko wa Luzu upande wa kusini, yaani Betheli; na mpaka unashuka hadi Atarothi-adari, juu ya kilima kilicho kusini mwa Beth-horoni ya Chini.
sw.B: Kutoka huko mpaka unapita kuelekea Luzu, kando ya mteremko wa kusini wa Luzu (yaani Betheli), na kushuka hadi Atarothi-adari, juu ya kilima kilicho kusini mwa Beth-horoni ya Chini.
sw.R: Kutoka huko mpaka ulienda hadi Luzu, yaani Betheli. Ulipita kando ya mteremko ulio kusini mwa mji huo. Kisha ukashuka hadi Atarothi-adari, ulio juu ya kilima kilicho kusini mwa Beth-horoni ya Chini.

es.L: Y de allí pasa la frontera hacia Luz, a la ladera de Luz por el sur, que [es] Betel; y baja la frontera a Atarot-adar, sobre el monte que [está] al sur de Bet-horón de abajo.
es.B: De allí la frontera pasa hacia Luz, por la ladera sur de Luz (es decir, Betel), y baja a Atarot-adar, en el monte que está al sur de Bet-horón de abajo.
es.R: Desde allí la frontera seguía hasta Luz, que es Betel. Pasaba por la ladera al sur del pueblo. Luego bajaba a Atarot-adar, que está en el monte al sur de Bet-horón de abajo.

fr.L: Et de là la frontière passe vers Louz, vers le flanc de Louz au sud, c’[est] Béthel ; et la frontière descend vers Ataroth-Addar, sur la montagne qui [est] au sud de Beth-Horon d’en bas.
fr.B: De là, la frontière passe vers Louz, le long du versant sud de Louz (c’est-à-dire Béthel), puis descend vers Ataroth-Addar, sur la colline qui se trouve au sud de Beth-Horon d’en bas.
fr.R: De là, la frontière allait jusqu’à Louz, c’est-à-dire Béthel. Elle longeait la colline au sud de la ville. Puis elle descendait jusqu’à Ataroth-Addar, qui est sur la colline au sud de Beth-Horon d’en bas.

vi.L: Từ đó ranh giới đi qua về phía Lu-xơ, đến sườn Lu-xơ ở phía nam, tức là Bê-tên; và ranh giới đi xuống A-ta-rốt-Át-đa, trên ngọn đồi [ở] phía nam Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ.
vi.B: Từ đó ranh giới đi qua về phía Lu-xơ, dọc sườn phía nam của Lu-xơ (tức là Bê-tên), rồi đi xuống A-ta-rốt-Át-đa, trên ngọn đồi ở phía nam Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ.
vi.R: Từ đó ranh giới đi đến Lu-xơ, tức là Bê-tên. Nó chạy dọc sườn đồi phía nam thị trấn ấy. Rồi nó đi xuống A-ta-rốt-Át-đa, nằm trên ngọn đồi phía nam Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 거기에서 루스 쪽으로, 곧 벧엘인 루스의 남쪽 비탈로 지나가고, 경계는 아래 벧호론 남쪽에 있는 산 위의 아다롯 앗달로 내려간다.
ko.B: 경계는 거기에서 루스 쪽으로 지나서 루스(곧 벧엘)의 남쪽 비탈을 따라가고, 아래 벧호론 남쪽 언덕 위에 있는 아다롯 앗달로 내려간다.
ko.R: 거기에서 경계는 벧엘이라고도 하는 루스로 갔다. 경계는 그 성읍의 남쪽 산비탈을 따라갔다. 그다음에 아래 벧호론 남쪽 언덕 위에 있는 아다롯 앗달로 내려갔다.

pt.L: E dali a fronteira passa para Luz, à encosta de Luz, ao sul, que [é] Betel; e a fronteira desce a Atarote-Adar, sobre o monte que [fica] ao sul de Bete-Horom de Baixo.
pt.B: Dali a fronteira passa em direção a Luz, pela encosta sul de Luz (isto é, Betel), e desce até Atarote-Adar, no monte que fica ao sul de Bete-Horom de Baixo.
pt.R: Dali a fronteira seguia até Luz, que é Betel. Ela passava pela encosta ao sul da cidade. Depois descia até Atarote-Adar, que fica no monte ao sul de Bete-Horom de Baixo.

decisions.choice: Luz, that is Bethel
decisions.reason: Luz was the old name of the town that Jacob named Bethel, "house of God" (Genesis 28:19; Judges 1:23). The border runs along the slope south of the town, so Bethel itself falls inside Benjamin's land (verse 22). In 16:2 Bethel and Luz appear to be told apart, perhaps as the holy place and the town beside it.

decisions.choice: Ataroth-addar and Lower Beth-horon: places on the road down to the west
decisions.reason: Beth-horon was a pair of towns, Upper and Lower, on the main road from the hills down to the coastal plain (10:10-11; 16:3, 5). Ataroth-addar stood on a hill south of the lower town; its exact site is not known.

decisions.choice: (that is, Bethel)
decisions.reason: Balanced sets the second name in brackets so the line of the border stays clear.

decisions.choice: went on to Luz, which is Bethel. It passed along the hillside south of the town.
decisions.reason: Readable names Luz once and gives its other name at once, then the detail of the slope, so the repetition of "Luz" does not confuse.

decisions.choice: Luz; Atarote-Adar; Bete-Horom de Baixo
decisions.reason: The usual Brazilian forms of the names, with each part of a compound name capitalised, as "Bete-Áven" (7:2): "Luz" as Genesis 28:19 has it in Portuguese, "-ote" for the plural ending -oth, "-om" for a final -on. "De Baixo" says "Lower" in plain Portuguese and is capitalised as part of the name.

source.text: וְתָאַ֣ר הַגְּבוּל֩ וְנָסַ֨ב לִפְאַת־יָ֜ם נֶ֗גְבָּה מִן־הָהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י בֵית־חֹרוֹן֮ נֶגְבָּה֒ וְהָי֣וּ תֹֽצְאֹתָ֗יו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּ֨עַל֙ הִ֚יא קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים עִ֖יר בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה זֹ֖את פְּאַת־יָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And is drawn the border and turns to [the] side [of the] west southward from the hill which [is] on [the] face of Beth-horon southward, and are its goings out to Kiriath-baal, that [is] Kiriath-jearim, a city of [the] sons of Judah. This [is the] side [of the] west.

en.L: And the border is drawn and turns on the west side southward, from the hill that [is] facing Beth-horon on the south, and its end is at Kiriath-baal, that [is] Kiriath-jearim, a city of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah. This [is] the west side.
en.B: Then the border bends and turns south along the western side, from the hill that faces Beth-horon on the south, and ends at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a town belonging to the people of Judah. This is the western side.
en.R: From the hill south of Beth-horon, the border turned south. That was the western side. It ended at Kiriath-baal, also called Kiriath-jearim, a town that belonged to the tribe of Judah.

sw.L: Na mpaka unazunguka na kugeuka upande wa magharibi kuelekea kusini, kutoka kilima kilicho mkabala na Beth-horoni upande wa kusini, na mwisho wake ni Kiriath-baali, yaani Kiriath-yearimu, mji wa wana wa Yuda. Huu [ndio] upande wa magharibi.
sw.B: Kisha mpaka unapinda na kugeuka kusini upande wa magharibi, kutoka kilima kinachoelekeana na Beth-horoni upande wa kusini, na kuishia Kiriath-baali (yaani Kiriath-yearimu), mji wa watu wa Yuda. Huo ndio upande wa magharibi.
sw.R: Kutoka kilima kilicho kusini mwa Beth-horoni, mpaka uligeuka kuelekea kusini. Huo ulikuwa upande wa magharibi. Uliishia Kiriath-baali, ambao pia huitwa Kiriath-yearimu, mji uliokuwa wa kabila la Yuda.

es.L: Y se traza la frontera y gira por el lado occidental hacia el sur, desde el monte que [está] frente a Bet-horón por el sur, y sus salidas están en Quiriat-baal, que [es] Quiriat-jearim, ciudad de los hijos de Judá. Este [es] el lado occidental.
es.B: Luego la frontera se curva y gira hacia el sur por el lado occidental, desde el monte que está frente a Bet-horón por el sur, y termina en Quiriat-baal (es decir, Quiriat-jearim), población de la gente de Judá. Este es el lado occidental.
es.R: Desde el monte al sur de Bet-horón, la frontera giraba hacia el sur. Ese era el lado oeste. Terminaba en Quiriat-baal, que también se llama Quiriat-jearim, un pueblo de la tribu de Judá.

fr.L: Et la frontière s’infléchit et tourne, du côté de l’occident, vers le sud, depuis la montagne qui [est] en face de Beth-Horon au sud, et ses issues sont à Kiryath-Baal, c’[est] Kiryath-Yearim, ville des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda. Ceci [est] le côté de l’occident.
fr.B: Puis la frontière s’incurve et tourne vers le sud du côté ouest, depuis la colline qui fait face à Beth-Horon au sud, et elle aboutit à Kiryath-Baal (c’est-à-dire Kiryath-Yearim), ville appartenant aux gens de Juda. Tel est le côté ouest.
fr.R: Depuis la colline au sud de Beth-Horon, la frontière tournait vers le sud. C’était le côté ouest. Elle se terminait à Kiryath-Baal, qu’on appelle aussi Kiryath-Yearim, une ville qui appartenait à la tribu de Juda.

vi.L: Ranh giới kéo dài và vòng ở phía tây về phía nam, từ ngọn đồi đối diện Bết-Hô-rôn ở phía nam, và cuối của nó là ở Ki-ri-át Ba-anh, tức là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim, một thành của con cháu Giu-đa. Đây [là] phía tây.
vi.B: Rồi ranh giới uốn cong và quay về phía nam dọc theo phía tây, từ ngọn đồi đối diện Bết-Hô-rôn ở phía nam, và dừng lại ở Ki-ri-át Ba-anh (tức là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim), một thị trấn thuộc về người Giu-đa. Đó là phía tây.
vi.R: Từ ngọn đồi phía nam Bết-Hô-rôn, ranh giới quay về phía nam. Đó là phía tây. Nó dừng lại ở Ki-ri-át Ba-anh, cũng gọi là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim, một thị trấn thuộc chi tộc Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 벧호론 남쪽 맞은편에 있는 산에서부터 서쪽 편으로 이어져 남쪽으로 돌아가고, 그 끝은 유다 자손의 성읍인 기럇바알, 곧 기럇여아림이다. 이것이 서쪽 편이다.
ko.B: 경계는 벧호론 남쪽을 마주한 언덕에서부터 서쪽 편을 따라 남쪽으로 굽어 돌아서, 유다 자손의 성읍인 기럇바알(곧 기럇여아림)에서 끝난다. 이것이 서쪽 편이다.
ko.R: 벧호론 남쪽 언덕에서 경계는 남쪽으로 돌았다. 그것이 서쪽 경계였다. 경계는 기럇여아림이라고도 하는 기럇바알에서 끝났는데, 그 성읍은 유다 지파의 것이었다.

pt.L: E a fronteira se estende e vira, no lado oeste, para o sul, desde o monte que [está] em frente de Bete-Horom, ao sul; e o seu extremo é em Quiriate-Baal, que [é] Quiriate-Jearim, cidade dos filhos de Judá. Este [é] o lado oeste.
pt.B: Depois a fronteira faz uma curva e vira para o sul, pelo lado oeste, desde o monte que fica em frente de Bete-Horom, ao sul, e termina em Quiriate-Baal (isto é, Quiriate-Jearim), uma cidade do povo de Judá. Este é o lado oeste.
pt.R: Do monte ao sul de Bete-Horom, a fronteira virava para o sul. Esse era o lado oeste. Ela terminava em Quiriate-Baal, também chamada Quiriate-Jearim, uma cidade que pertencia à tribo de Judá.

decisions.choice: is drawn and turns: the line changes direction
decisions.reason: The first verb means to mark out or trace a line (15:9, 11). With "turns" it describes the border bending from its westward course to run south.

decisions.choice: west: literally "sea"
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:6, the word for "west" is the word for "sea", because the Mediterranean lies west of the land.

decisions.choice: Kiriath-baal, that is Kiriath-jearim: a town of Judah on the border
decisions.reason: Kiriath-jearim, "town of forests", was also called Kiriath-baal or Baalah (15:9, 60). It was one of the Gibeonite towns (9:17) and lay in Judah's land; there the ark later stayed for twenty years (1 Samuel 7:1-2). Benjamin's western side ends at its edge.

decisions.choice: they are: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: As in verse 12.

decisions.choice: That was the western side.
decisions.reason: Readable puts the summary right after the turn, then names the end point, so the reader knows which side is being described.

decisions.choice: "서쪽" for the Hebrew "sea" side
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "sea" for west, since the sea lies to the west of the land (meaning decision m2). Korean "바다 쪽" would not be read as a compass direction, so Literal also says "서쪽".

decisions.choice: Quiriate-Baal, Quiriate-Jearim
decisions.reason: The Brazilian forms of the names (m3): "qu" for k before i, "-ate" for the construct ending of Kiriath. The same forms for the whole book.

source.text: וּפְאַת־נֶ֕גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֖ה קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבוּל֙ יָ֔מָּה וְיָצָ֕א אֶל־מַעְיַ֖ן מֵ֥י נֶפְתּֽוֹחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] side southward [is] from [the] end of Kiriath-jearim, and goes out the border westward, and goes out to [the] spring of [the] waters of Nephtoah.

en.L: And the south side [is] from the edge of Kiriath-jearim; and the border goes out westward and goes out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
en.B: The southern side starts from the edge of Kiriath-jearim. The border goes out westward and on to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
en.R: The southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-jearim. It went out westward and on to the spring at Nephtoah.

sw.L: Na upande wa kusini [ni] kutoka ukingo wa Kiriath-yearimu; na mpaka unatokea kuelekea magharibi na kutokea hadi chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa.
sw.B: Upande wa kusini unaanzia ukingo wa Kiriath-yearimu. Mpaka unatokea kuelekea magharibi hadi chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa.
sw.R: Mpaka wa kusini ulianzia ukingo wa Kiriath-yearimu. Ulienda kuelekea magharibi hadi chemchemi ya Neftoa.

es.L: Y el lado sur [va] desde el extremo de Quiriat-jearim; y sale la frontera al occidente, y sale al manantial de las aguas de Neftoa.
es.B: El lado sur empieza en el extremo de Quiriat-jearim. La frontera sale hacia el occidente y llega al manantial de las aguas de Neftoa.
es.R: La frontera sur empezaba en el extremo de Quiriat-jearim. Iba hacia el oeste y llegaba al manantial de Neftoa.

fr.L: Et le côté du sud [part] de l’extrémité de Kiryath-Yearim ; et la frontière sort vers l’occident, et sort vers la source des eaux de Nephtoah.
fr.B: Le côté sud part de l’extrémité de Kiryath-Yearim. La frontière sort vers l’ouest et va jusqu’à la source des eaux de Nephtoah.
fr.R: La frontière sud commençait au bord de Kiryath-Yearim. Elle allait vers l’ouest jusqu’à la source de Nephtoah.

vi.L: Phía nam [là] từ bìa Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim; ranh giới đi ra về phía tây và đi ra đến nguồn nước Nép-thô-ách.
vi.B: Phía nam bắt đầu từ bìa Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim. Ranh giới đi ra về phía tây và tiếp đến nguồn nước Nép-thô-ách.
vi.R: Ranh giới phía nam bắt đầu ở bìa Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim. Nó đi về phía tây và tiếp đến con suối ở Nép-thô-ách.

ko.L: 그리고 남쪽 편은 기럇여아림 끝에서부터[이다]. 그리고 경계는 서쪽으로 나가서 넵도아 샘물로 나간다.
ko.B: 남쪽 편은 기럇여아림 끝에서 시작된다. 경계는 서쪽으로 나가서 넵도아 샘물에 이른다.
ko.R: 남쪽 경계는 기럇여아림 끝에서 시작되었다. 경계는 서쪽으로 나가서 넵도아 샘에 이르렀다.

pt.L: E o lado sul [é] desde a extremidade de Quiriate-Jearim; e a fronteira sai para o oeste e sai para a fonte das águas de Neftoa.
pt.B: O lado sul começa na extremidade de Quiriate-Jearim. A fronteira sai para o oeste e segue até a fonte das águas de Neftoa.
pt.R: A fronteira sul começava na extremidade de Quiriate-Jearim. Ela seguia para o oeste e ia até a fonte de Neftoa.

decisions.choice: the south side: Judah's northern border traced from west to east
decisions.reason: The southern border of Benjamin follows the northern border of Judah (15:5-9), but in the other direction, from Kiriath-jearim east to the Dead Sea.

decisions.choice: westward: an unexpected direction
alternatives: the border starts on the west side of the town
a place name has dropped out
decisions.reason: The word means "westward" or "toward the sea", but from Kiriath-jearim the border runs east toward Nephtoah and Jerusalem (15:9). It may mean that the line starts on the west side of the town, or the text may once have named a place here. The words as they stand are kept.

decisions.choice: the spring of the waters of Nephtoah: a spring west of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The same spring marks Judah's border in 15:9. It is usually placed at Lifta, a village just north-west of Jerusalem, but this is not certain.

decisions.choice: the spring at Nephtoah
decisions.reason: Readable shortens "the spring of the waters of Nephtoah" to "the spring at Nephtoah", which names the same place.

source.text: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־קְצֵ֣ה הָהָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵי֙ גֵּ֣י בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַד֩ גֵּ֨י הִנֹּ֜ם אֶל־כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה וְיָרַ֖ד עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes down the border to [the] end of the hill which [is] on [the] face of [the] valley of Ben-hinnom, which [is] in [the] valley of Rephaim northward, and goes down [the] valley of Hinnom to [the] slope of the Jebusite southward, and goes down [to] En-rogel.

en.L: And the border goes down to the foot of the hill that [is] facing the valley of Ben-hinnom, which [is] in the valley of Rephaim on the north; and it goes down the valley of Hinnom to the slope of the Jebusite on the south, and goes down to En-rogel.
en.B: The border then goes down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben-hinnom, at the north end of the Valley of Rephaim. It runs down the Valley of Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and down to En-rogel.
en.R: Then it went down to the bottom of the hill that looks out over the Hinnom Valley, at the north end of the Rephaim Valley. It went down the Hinnom Valley, along the hillside south of the city of the Jebusites. Then it went down to the spring of En-rogel.

sw.L: Na mpaka unashuka hadi mwisho wa kilima kilicho mkabala na bonde la Ben-hinomu, ulio katika bonde la Refaimu upande wa kaskazini; na unashuka bonde la Hinomu hadi mteremko wa Myebusi upande wa kusini, na kushuka hadi En-rogeli.
sw.B: Kisha mpaka unashuka hadi chini ya kilima kinachoelekeana na Bonde la Ben-hinomu, upande wa kaskazini wa Bonde la Refaimu. Unashuka Bonde la Hinomu kando ya mteremko wa kusini wa mji wa Wayebusi, hadi En-rogeli.
